Hi Aisha (and audit team),

Thanks for the clear scope. Attached are two things: a short attestation template you can drop into your audit packet (Deletion_Attestation_Template) and a brief narrative that ties controls to SOC 2 criteria. Key points in the attestation:
- Redwood retains deletion metadata for 90 days (audit logs) and 30 days for tombstone markers before final object-store shredding for tenant-scoped data by default; enterprise contracts can alter these windows.
- Deletion events are logged with audit_id and job_id and are immutable in our logging layer; hashes for exported rows allow auditors to verify that export contents match the internal deletion records.
- For cross-region customers we include a residency map in the export and indicate the region(s) from which objects were removed.

Attachments: [deletion_attestation_examples_v1.docx] (contains the short attestation + SOC 2 mapping).

Marissa
